notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Tales of Graces f Remastered.
 A new update for Tales of Graces f Remastered has been released! 

■Contents:
・Some adjustments to simplified text.

notes.title: Patch notes for Tales of Graces f Remastered version 1.0.0
notes.notes:
A patch has been distributed to improve gameplay stability. We apologize for the inconvenience, but please update to the latest patch before playing the game.

When this patch is applied, the version on the bottom right of the title screen will read as follows:
Ver. 1.0.0

Update Details:
・Sound Effect adjustments.
・Fixed an issue of the number of hits for Artes.
・Other minor issues have been fixed. 
・Sound test issue has been fixed.

An Internet connection is required to apply the update.
Thank you for your cooperation.
